ai_report.headline: Portfolio Rebalanced: Sector Redundancy Pruned, Momentum Leaders Added
ai_report.summary: Executed strategic rotation by selling three stagnant/negative positions (RF, FITB, GBPUSD=X) to eliminate regional bank overexposure and free up capacity. Reinvested into high-momentum leaders MMM and MRK, alongside a top-ranked EURUSD=X long position, maintaining strict risk limits and a max 12-ticker book. Executed: SELL 85.0 RF; SELL 43.0 FITB; BUY 1950.0 EURUSD=X; SELL 1800.0 GBPUSD=X; BUY 12.0 MMM; BUY 16.0 MRK
ai_report.market_read: Broad market breadth remains overwhelmingly bullish (100% UP trend), with low volatility in consolidation patterns across large caps and select currency pairs. Momentum continuation in industrials and healthcare offers strong upside.
ai_report.risk_notes: All new purchases are strictly capped within the 12% cash rule (~$2,260 per trade) and guarded with tight stop losses (3% equity, 1% FX). Open ticker count remains balanced at exactly the 12-asset cap.
ai_report.outlook: Portfolio is well positioned with broader sector diversification across Financials, Healthcare, Industrials, Utilities, and Forex to maximize realized returns and protect paper equity.
